row: This is the online video library of Licensed Massage Therapist, Pal Kokity. On here I will be posting instructional videos talking about the various techniques that I do an how I approach working with peoples' bodies. Also, I hope to develop self-care instructional videos to help out people who do not live near me in the Chicago area. You can learn more about me and my services at www.KokityMassage.com
